contract: One recorded pure pattern cycle and ordinary dispatcher per host Unit/Run: shared sealed request charge, schema/identity/committed host gate/Budget/authority/Approval checks, occurrence-first settlement, durable owner composition and explicit fail-stop recovery; charge exhaustion stops generation while retaining prior within-cap obligations, without new work or resend permission.
limits: Host provides authenticated correlation/current authority, checked pure prompt patterns/bindings/schemas, exclusive matching Store/Lease construction, ordinary supervision, clocks/wakes, capacity, outcome sink and physical fencing/outstanding-write confirmation before recovery. Byte caps are not a sandbox.

No model/tool/Lua dependency, recipe loader, child Run, outside-event action, cluster ownership, scheduler, hot configuration, implicit reopen, retry/rearm/reset or later-wave capability. One Run stream belongs exclusively to RunApprovalRelease; old Run remains unchanged.

Payload JSON <=65536 bytes/depth32; ingress <=262144; complete record/output <=16777216; control <=2097152 with future settlement/receipt reservations; slot <=131072, 64 active/256 lifetime occurrences; request map <=4456448; checkpoint <=33554432 including model, retained IDs, full replay witnesses and framing. Complete encoded bounds are authoritative; no truncation or borrowed future settlement capacity.

Request cap 1..256 is sealed per Run, shared with nested callables and never replenished by Attempt, pause/continue or restart. First excess creates only charge/stop bookkeeping, not actions/verdicts/outcomes/joins or a pattern input. Room rollover is explicit after prior terminal obligations settle; lifetime-action capacity is not reset.

FIFO DU input retention does not bound retained log/witness memory or recovery time. Full retained history is required for audit; pruned/damaged/incompatible history errors. Oversize checkpoint refuses nonfatally; no perpetual checkpoint guarantee.

Finite disposable-PostgreSQL/counting-fake-provider evidence, not production monitoring, universal proof, exactly-once external effects or physical no-send/cancellation. Unknown cost is not zero; Budget estimates do not enforce provider charges. Reserved intents/lost raw sink values never authorize resend.

grounding.claim: The 13 published named groups exercise recorded non-agent publication, charge/retained obligations, gate order/first verdict/restart, append rejection/uncertainty, reused occurrences/read-only audit, ASK/resource release, intent recovery, persistent Budget/nesting, Attempt routing, local recovery/cancel, lifecycle, resource consumption/cleanup and encoded bounds with real ready APIs and disposable PostgreSQL. Temporary actual production gate/first-settlement bypasses are negative controls; listed finite scenarios, not quantified proofs.
Pinned GenServer serialization, Registry/DynamicSupervisor and Task semantics compose ready owner Contracts; no local OTP runtime proof.
OTP29.1.2 deterministic minor-version-2 ETF/safe decoding and SHA-256 identities; full encoded bounds are checked, not inferred from JSON length.
Pinned compact JSON encoding/decoding retains admitted requests and originals; ready PayloadSchema owns JSON representation/depth/schema checks.

Host callbacks are prompt pure checked decisions where required, retain stable compatible identity/binding/schema bytes, authenticate people/results/current authority, serialize Run mutation with admission, preserve full durable history and fence old tasks/owners/providers. Fake observations and local PostgreSQL tests do not establish production fencing or vendor behavior. Reused Cure laws retain only their dependency-local scopes; no new engine proof or monitor is claimed.

telemetry.contract: OTP diagnostics only with redacted engine format_status; no custom telemetry, payload exporter or durable audit through observations.

config.contract: Fixed required host infrastructure, checked pattern/schema/gate/action bindings, explicit Run/period, request cap, monetary Budget, lifecycle rule/deadline and evidence Writer; compatible restart only, no defaults or hot replacement.

control.contract: Trusted stable-ID input and begin-Attempt/Approval evidence-revocation/pause/verified continue/targeted cancel through existing owners; committed status and explicit host recovery, no generic router/reset/rearm or physical cancellation promise.
